title: Transmutation based Quantum Simulation for Non-unitary Dynamics
summary: We present a quantum algorithm for simulating dissipative diffusion dynamics generated by positive semidefinite operators of the form $A=L^\dagger L$, a structure that arises naturally in standard discretizations of elliptic operators. Our main tool is the Kannai transform, which represents the diffusion semigroup $e^{-AT}$, where $T$ is the final simulation time, as a Gaussian-weighted superposition of unitary wave propagators.
